newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strike grounds Air France freighters.
newsitem.headline: Strike grounds Air France freighters.

text.p: Air France said three of its Boeing 747-200 freighters had been unable to leave Paris-CDG as scheduled following a strike by the airline's freight handling personnel which began Thursday afternoon.
"The three freighters are grounded and in addition, we had to divert another freighter bound for CDG to Brussels," an airline official told Reuters.
Activity at Air France Cargo's CDG freight centre, where the airline employs around 1,400 staff has been brought to a standstill and cargo reservations suspended.
Air France's cargo handling activities at Paris-Orly airport had not been affected by the stoppage, the official added.
The striking personnel were due to meet at 1400 GMT this afternoon to vote to discuss the dispute which is in protest against a new wage structure.

One union source said: "The strike will be probably be over soon but the weekend freighter programme is likely to be badly hit because a good number staff will not return to work before Monday now." --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
